description: Compiles and runs Q0613A (06-13, embedded SQL SET OPTION/SELECT INTO/UPDATE/SQLSTATE/GET DIAGNOSTICS against TOKUIM) and Q0614A (06-14 'JUCINQ4S', cursor + multi-row FETCH + PREPARE/? dynamic SQL over TOKUIM/JUCHUM, standalone - NOT wired to the JUCINQ command). CRTSQLRPGI syntax verified directly against work/design/refs/cl_commands_75.txt's own parameter table (OBJ/SRCFILE/SRCMBR/OBJTYPE/COMMIT, lines ~4095-4127), resolving the P24-ladder manifest's earlier flagged uncertainty about whether SRCFILE/SRCMBR (member-based) is valid alongside SRCSTMF (IFS-based) - both are documented, separate, optional parameters. Both programs report via a program-described QSYSPRT printer file (not DSPLY), captured as spooled-file text via the same CPYSPLF-to-permanent-PF technique used elsewhere in Part 6's manifests. Also compiles and runs Q0613V (verify/part06-1314-sql/src/q0613v.sqlrpgle), a verify-only variant of Q0613A with only 'commit = *none,' dropped from its SET OPTION line (compiled without any CRTSQLRPGI COMMIT() parameter either, so it precompiles under CRTSQLRPGI's own default, COMMIT(*CHG)) - the source header's own 'how to reproduce SQL7008' recipe, applied here instead of left untested. Per the header's citations, SQL7008 should surface on Q0613V's UPDATE if TOKUIM is not journaled (COMMIT(*CHG) needs a journal to record the change; a plain read does not). Whether TOKUIM is actually journaled (P12) has not been confirmed by any prior connection. 2026-09-27, connection 1: QSYS2.SYSTABLES.JOURNALED does not exist on this system (SQL42703, 'Column or global variable JOURNALED not found') - replaced with a QSYS2.SYSCOLUMNS discovery query that asks the system itself for the real column name instead of guessing again.

steps.label: VSPLPF
steps.cmd:
CHKOBJ OBJ(&LIB/VFYSPL) OBJTYPE(*FILE)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF9801) EXEC(CRTPF FILE(&LIB/VFYSPL) RCDLEN(133) TEXT('Part 6 spooled-file text capture'))

steps.label: CPQ0613A
steps.cmd: CRTSQLRPGI OBJ(&LIB/Q0613A) SRCFILE(&LIB/QRPGLESRC) SRCMBR(Q0613A) OBJTYPE(*PGM) COMMIT(*NONE)

steps.label: CAPQ0613A
steps.cmd: CPYSPLF FILE(QSYSPRT) TOFILE(&LIB/VFYSPL) SPLNBR(*LAST) JOB(*) CTLCHAR(*NONE) MBROPT(*ADD)

steps.label: CAPQ0613V
steps.cmd: CPYSPLF FILE(QSYSPRT) TOFILE(&LIB/VFYSPL) SPLNBR(*LAST) JOB(*) CTLCHAR(*NONE) MBROPT(*ADD)

steps.label: CPQ0614A
steps.cmd: CRTSQLRPGI OBJ(&LIB/Q0614A) SRCFILE(&LIB/QRPGLESRC) SRCMBR(Q0614A) OBJTYPE(*PGM) COMMIT(*NONE)

steps.label: CAPQ0614A
steps.cmd: CPYSPLF FILE(QSYSPRT) TOFILE(&LIB/VFYSPL) SPLNBR(*LAST) JOB(*) CTLCHAR(*NONE) MBROPT(*ADD)

steps.sql: SELECT COLUMN_NAME FROM QSYS2.SYSCOLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'QSYS2' AND TABLE_NAME = 'SYSTABLES' AND (COLUMN_NAME LIKE '%JOURN%' OR COLUMN_NAME LIKE '%JRN%')
